import datetime
from typing import Optional

def next_billing_date(start: datetime.date, months_ahead: int) -> datetime.date:
    # Handle zero months_ahead case
    if months_ahead == 0:
        return start
    
    # Calculate the target year and month
    total_months = start.month + months_ahead
    year = start.year + (total_months - 1) // 12
    month = (total_months - 1) % 12 + 1
    
    # Determine the maximum day in the target month
    max_days_in_month = (datetime.date(year, month + 1, 1) - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).day
    
    # Use the original day or the last day of the month if original day exceeds max days
    day = min(start.day, max_days_in_month)
    
    return datetime.date(year, month, day)

    max_days_in_month = (datetime.date(year, month + 1, 1) - datetime.timedelta(days=1)).day
